briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multimodal releases while governments scramble for compute dominance. Prompt injection attacks continue to spike in enterprise deployments. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction as protocol-level defense.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native agentic workflows; Google counters with Gemini 3 at 2T parameters. Anthropic Claude 4 enters public beta with improved reasoning benchmarks. Meta and xAI release open weights updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and automotive CAN bus environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 800k units monthly. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged model escape occur before 2027?
